style: upbeat preschool kids electro pop sing-along, cheerful playful male vocal, clear diction, bright synths, bleepy robot sounds, handclaps, bouncy drums, major key, catchy repetitive chorus, vocals start immediately on the very first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short outro
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Why do leaves change color in the fall?
Red and orange, yellow, and all!
The green goes away and the colors show,
That's how autumn leaves glow!

[Verse 1]
All summer long the leaves are green,
Making food, the best you've seen!
They use the sunlight, water, and air,
Green, green leaves everywhere!

[Chorus]
Why do leaves change color in the fall?
Red and orange, yellow, and all!
The green goes away and the colors show,
That's how autumn leaves glow!

[Verse 2]
When fall comes, the days get short,
Less sunlight of every sort!
The green fades out, and then, surprise,
Yellow and orange meet our eyes!

[Bridge]
Fall like a leaf, twirl, twirl, twirl!
Float down softly, give a swirl!
Crunch, crunch, crunch on the ground,
Jump in a leaf pile, all around!

[Verse 3]
Then leaves let go and fall below,
The tree rests through the winter snow!
In spring new green leaves grow again,
The cycle starts, now count to ten!

[Chorus]
Why do leaves change color in the fall?
Red and orange, yellow, and all!
The green goes away and the colors show,
That's how autumn leaves glow!

[Outro]
Autumn leaves! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Why Do Leaves Change Color? Science Song for Kids with Gizmo
meta.description:
Why do leaves change color in the fall? Gizmo the robot explains that green leaves use sunlight to make food all summer. When fall brings shorter days, the green fades and the yellow and orange show through. Then leaves drop, the tree rests in winter and new leaves grow in spring.
Kids twirl like falling leaves and jump in a leaf pile. Ages 3-6.
